scope: Synthetic local system capability comparison; no model training and no production services.
grading: Structural checks only until manualReview is added. Completion is not correctness.
metricNotes: First token measures first nonempty text callback, not hidden thinking or tool-call tokens.
RAM/CPU sampled at approximately 500ms for all local ollama and llama-server processes; not whole-machine peaks.
Node CPU is the runner only, excluding local model inference.
Per-call generation limits match; enhanced multi-step tasks can spend up to four calls.
